name: Why should I get a roof inspection before selling my home?

mainEntity.name: Why should I get a roof inspection before selling my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Getting a roof inspection before selling helps you understand the roof's current state and address any necessary repairs ahead of time. This proactive approach can reduce surprises during a buyer's inspection, potentially saving time and money by avoiding last-minute repair negotiations or price reductions. It also allows you to choose your roofing contractor and schedule repairs on your terms, rather than under pressure from a closing deadline.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pre-sale roof inspection helps you address issues proactively, avoid surprises from buyer inspections, and manage repairs on your schedule.
